messages:
maria: Heads-up — proposal to add a ‘rehydrate’ flow in the Console that can run a dry-run estimate and then kick a backfill job to Dedicated backfill cluster. Want feedback on API & UX before I write the spec.
ajay: +1 to dry-run. We need clear cost and time estimates. Can the dry-run return a sample of affected aggregates? :eyes:
maria: plan is dry-run => returns rows scanned, estimated token-hours, and a 95th perc latency projection. also a tiny preview of 20 aggregate keys. thinking of a `dry_run=true` flag on the new POST /rehydrate endpoint.
lucas: routing question: will jobs go to normal Dedicated pool or a separate backfill pool? we should avoid starving online serving.
oliver: data caveat — late events for EU region still land with delayed IDs; dry-run must include a delta estimate for out-of-order events, otherwise results look optimistic.
ajay: API suggestion: POST /rehydrate {partition, start_ts, end_ts, priority, dry_run} Response: {estimated_cost, est_duration, sample_rows}. keep it minimal.
sophie: UX: in Console show a toggle for "dry run" with a link to sample rows. Add a checkbox for "auto-fallback to lower-priority lane" so ops can opt into graceful backoff.
maria: good. question about quotas: should rehydrate consume normal replay quota or a separate backfill quota? my read: separate quota with adjustable knob per org to protect tenants.
lucas: separate quota sounds right. also need a quota-bucket label on the job so routing/fair-share can treat it differently. e.g., `quota=rehydrate` on request metadata.
oliver: can we make dry_run compute using existing snapshot indices rather than full scans to speed up estimates? avoids triggering expensive list operations.
ajay: yep — dry_run can sample using index stats and produce confidence interval. we should surface `ci_lower` and `ci_upper` in response.
maria: edge-case: if index stats are stale, mark dry_run as "low confidence" and require explicit confirmation to run. Add a warning in UI.
sophie: rollout UX: feature flag per org, gradual enablement. need console banner that shows the quota cost before starting. include :warning: and an override for admins.
replay-bot: job created: rehydrate:job:1714123601 by maria (dry_run=true) — estimated_cost=42 token-hours, est_duration=18m.
ajay: thanks — can we add `simulate=false` to test fallback logic? sometimes dry_run doesn't catch contention.
lucas: implementation note: scheduler needs to support `priority` lanes (low, normal, high) and preemption signals. I can prototype handler by EOD.
oliver: add telemetry events: rehydrate.request, rehydrate.preview, rehydrate.start, rehydrate.finish, rehydrate.error. include `confidence_level` and `quota_bucket` fields.
maria: approved plan to draft RFC. will include API shape, console mockups, and quota proposal. tagging @sophie for rollout steps and @lucas for scheduler changes. thanks all.
